text: Coordination: new umbrella epic bd-01M02Q0KTM9JMPSA8K6YEGDZEC (Vision alignment, docs/plans/2026-08-15-vision-alignment.md) sequences the code-side work these gates depend on. Phase 1 bd-01M02Q12PNQ42166XXQAQ11JD5: contract-integrity fixes (learned-metric admission hard-codes metric_status='fixed'; generalization identity rides on free-text partition labels; route-dependent plan ids; unclassed refusals). Phase 2 bd-01M02Q1GMXYXQ5N74WJR8MTDQF: makes query-first true before Gate 5 certifies it — current measurement is rdm(plan) 3.5-3.9x SLOWER than materialization at q>=32 with an O(q^4) eager query matrix, so Gate 5 should not run until it lands. Phase 3 bd-01M02Q206NSX0P8SREERBFER5B: exports rectangular plans, which Gate 3 needs. This epic is linked under the umbrella's Phase 4 bd-01M02Q2FGGSNRW4438VWME7ATY.
